title: German-language brief: German copy, English camera and music directions
runtime: any shell runtime (Path C), dry-run only
prompt: Erstelle mit dem scene-machine Skill das Storyboard fuer einen 30-Sekunden-Werbespot. Marke: NordicGlow Skincare, Produkt: Radiant Renewal Serum mit arktischen Moltebeeren. Zielgruppe: Erwachsene 25-45. Kernaussage: +84% Feuchtigkeit in 24 Stunden. Farben: #0F172A, #38BDF8, #F59E0B, #F8FAFC. Bitte noch nichts rendern.
expected_behaviour: Voiceover script, voiceoverSegments, typoOverlay headlines and the endcard copy are German; visualPrompt and motionPrompt camera/lighting text are English; language is de-DE; musicPrompt is English ASCII (lyria-002 accepts en-US prompts); the voiceover has 50-65 words; the dry-run passes validation.
deterministic_checks: audioSpec.musicPrompt.isascii() and the dry-run validation reports music_prompt_ascii true
voiceoverScript contains at least three common German function words (und, mit, fuer/fur, der, die, das, ist)
no German function words inside any motionPrompt [CAMERA TRAJECTORY] clause
pass_criteria: all deterministic checks pass and the judge mean >= 1.5
